variants.pose: She is studying an open small navy blue book held at chest level in both hands. Her bright eyes look down thoughtfully at the pages, tiny gentle focused smile, attentive and curious. variants.label: 无聊

Endearing restless patience, awake and bored rather than sleepy. Standing same feet baseline, no props.
